The ocean covers more than seventy percent of our planet, yet vast stretches of this underwater world remain unexplored. For decades, marine biologists have faced the monumental task of manually reviewing thousands of hours of underwater footage to track marine ecosystems, catalog biodiversity, and identify endangered species. The impact of this technology on marine conservation is profound. Deep-learning models enable scientists to map complex underwater habitats, track the migration patterns of whales across entire ocean basins, and monitor protected marine reserves for illegal fishing activity.
